h1: Custom Tangle Buttons for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Tangle buttons with your logo. Perfect for events and giveaways. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Tangle buttons offer a unique tactile experience that sets them apart from standard promotional buttons. Their twistable, fidget-friendly design makes them a memorable giveaway for trade shows, employee wellness programs, or stress relief kits. Available in various sizes and colors, these buttons can be imprinted with your logo using screen printing or pad printing. Choose Tangle buttons when you want a promotional item that recipients will actually keep and use.
heroAltText: Custom Tangle buttons with company logo in assorted colors for promotional giveaways
